evidence_classification.classic_evidence: Only a Classic column/fact or the evidenced absence of an approved Classic source field.
evidence_classification.approved_policy: An upstream owner-approved rule; never relabelled as Classic evidence.
evidence_classification.technical_recommendation: A proposed target representation without persistence authority.

commit_block_reason: No owner-approved coherent initialization exists for status, is_active, is_temporary, merge_status, is_deceased, deleted_at/activation and updated_at. Classified dry-run quarantine remains required and does not stop later classification or reconciliation stages.

records.installed_type: varchar(191) NOT NULL; no database value check
records.allowed_values: Database accepts any varchar up to 191; installed application behavior uses active, inactive, archived and deceased.
records.application_semantics: Controls active/inactive/deceased/archive visibility and workflows and must agree with is_active, merge and death state.
records.default_safety_rationale: Unsafe as migration authority: PATIENT-REQ-007 says no approved source derivation/state policy exists and silent default use is invalid.
records.classic_evidence: Classic patients contains BillStatus but no separate source column corresponding to the renewed patient status field.
records.approved_policy: PATIENT-COL-015 makes BillStatus payer evidence and forbids using it as patient status; PATIENT-REQ-007 requires an explicit owner-approved coherent state.
records.technical_recommendation: active for a newly created, fully eligible permanent patient
records.technical_recommendation_rationale: Matches the installed visible-patient vocabulary only if the owner approves the complete tuple; it is not a Classic fact.
records.reconciliation: PATIENT-REC-REQ-007; every outcome is explicit, state-policy-pending is quarantined, and implicit default count equals zero.
records.phase3_requirement: Implement a validator that accepts only the owner-approved value within the coherent tuple and records the field exception/quarantine without stopping dry-run classification.

records.allowed_values: false or true
records.application_semantics: Patient::active() requires both status=active and is_active=true; an independent boolean can create an incoherent visible state.
records.default_safety_rationale: Unsafe as migration authority: PATIENT-REQ-008 explicitly rejects silent default 1 without joint status approval.
records.classic_evidence: Classic patients exposes no approved source field or row-level fact for renewed is_active.
records.approved_policy: PATIENT-REQ-008 requires an explicit boolean derived jointly with status.
records.technical_recommendation_rationale: Coherent only with an owner-approved active status for a visible permanent new patient; it is not evidence.
records.reconciliation: PATIENT-REC-REQ-008; status/is_active tuple differences and implicit-default count equal zero.
records.phase3_requirement: Validate status and is_active atomically, quarantine pending policy, and prevent model/database default application.

records.allowed_values: Only an owner-approved tuple satisfying every primary/subordinate rule; no field may be omitted to a default.
records.application_semantics: The tuple jointly governs patient visibility, temporary workflow, confirmation, merge, death, attribution, deletion and timestamps.
records.installed_default: Independent per-column defaults only; no tuple default exists.
records.default_safety_rationale: Unsafe: independent defaults can form an apparently valid but unevidenced/incoherent target state.
records.classic_evidence: Classic patients provides RegDate and EditDate columns but no set of source columns representing a complete renewed patient-state tuple.
records.approved_policy: PATIENT-REQ-007 through 011 require joint explicit approval and TARGET_PATIENT_IDENTITY_CONTRACT requires coherence.
records.technical_recommendation: status=active, is_active=true, is_temporary=false, merge_status=ACTIVE, is_deceased=false; subordinate event/actor fields null; registered_by=null; deleted_at=null; created_at=validated RegDate; updated_at=null/not evidenced
records.technical_recommendation_rationale: Provides a coherent candidate for owner review while explicitly retaining every unresolved primary-state, activation and timestamp decision.
records.existing_target_behavior: Never normalize or backfill an existing target to this tuple.
records.reconciliation: Every field outcome is explicit; all applicable exception/quarantine counts reconcile; invalid subordinate combinations and default reliance equal zero.
records.phase3_requirement: Implement one versioned atomic tuple validator/persistence boundary; classify unresolved roots as commit-blocked quarantine and still complete dry-run, history and reconciliation.
